article.story: WASHINGTON -- — Jean Aranguren had 17 points in George Washington’s 75-61 win over Hampton on Saturday. Aranguren shot 4 of 7 from the field, including 2 for 4 from 3-point range, and went 7 for 9 from the line for the Revolutionaries (2-0). Dylan James scored 15 points and added nine rebounds and four blocks. Ryder Frost had nine points and went 4 of 6 from the field. Seth Hubbard finished with 14 points for the Pirates (0-2). Max Frazier added 10 points for Hampton. Aaron Davis also had nine points. George Washington took the lead for good with 8:42 remaining in the first half. The score was 41-27 at halftime, with Aranguren racking up 14 points. George Washington extended its lead to 69-52 during the second half, fueled by a 9-2 scoring run. Frost scored a team-high seven points in the second half. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
